per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Screens and UI shall be visually consistent with corporate pages (consistent layout, button placement, fonts, and colors) to reduce user errors and improve learnability.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All screens created as part of the Disputes application must comply with corporate standards for interface creation.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Search result lists shall use consistent visual cues (including color coding) that clearly distinguish statuses such as urgent/pending/closed so users can rapidly scan and identify priority items without opening each record.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The list of dispute cases that are displayed after a search is performed must be color coded for easy identification of dispute cases based upon the dispute case status.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Common UI actions (e.g., navigating between list and case details) shall respond within 2 seconds for typical operations and never exceed 5 seconds for interactive actions, to ensure the interface feels snappy.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The maximum wait time for a user navigating from one screen to another within the Disputes application shall be no more than 5 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Integrations shall use authoritative backend systems as sources of truth for transaction, cardmember, and merchant data; the dispute UI must not permit manual edits that diverge from those sources without an auditable override.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall interface with the Statement Database. The Statement Database provides the transaction details to the Disputes System. All transaction details must be obtained from the Statement Database'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: When backend integrations fail or cannot return data, the UI shall surface clear, user-friendly error messages indicating the cause (e.g., backend unavailable) and recommended next steps (retry, create ticket, contact support).
The system shall provide reliable audit logs recording who accessed or modified a case, what change was made, and when; logs must be exportable for compliance audits over arbitrary timeframes.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall ensure that only authorized users are allowed to logon to the application.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Access to the system shall be restricted to authorized personnel and enforced such that users can only view disputes for cardmembers they are assigned or responsible for; team leads may require broader visibility per role-based permissions.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes System must prevent users from accessing any dispute cases that do not belong to their cardholder base.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall be highly available during business hours; planned maintenance windows are acceptable and should normally be scheduled Monday–Saturday around 3 AM and Sunday between 1 AM and 5 AM.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall be available 24x7x365 with the exception of the following scheduled maintenance windows. Monday â€“ Saturday 3:00am to 4:00am EST Sunday 1:00amd to 5:00am EST'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Navigation shall preserve context: when users jump from a list to a case and back, the system must restore the list position, filters, and search state so users do not have to repeat searches.
Color usage for status indicators shall be consistent with corporate look-and-feel (e.g., red-ish for items needing action) and adhere to accessibility contrast guidelines to avoid confusion.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The list of dispute cases that are displayed after a search is performed must be color coded for easy identification of dispute cases based upon the dispute case status.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall queue and persist outgoing letter requests when the print utility is unavailable, retrying delivery or surfacing the request in a holding area so the user does not lose the request.

If a backend fetch fails for a transaction detail, the system shall offer explicit recovery options such as retry and 'create a ticket for the backend team' to ensure tasks can continue or be escalated.
The system shall provide clear, plain-language error messages and consistent button labels to reduce helpdesk calls and speed onboarding.
The system shall provide reminders or flags for overdue follow-ups and outstanding tasks to reduce reliance on memory and prevent missed actions.
The letters workflow shall integrate with the existing Letters utility such that the system programmatically requests letter creation/printing rather than requiring manual PDF creation by users.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall interface with the Letters application. This will allow the Disputes application to request letters as part of the dispute initiation and dispute follow up process. All letter requests must be sent to the Print Letter Utility application.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall provide straightforward reporting or a consolidated view to display case histories and related records for audits or process verification.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The list of dispute cases that are displayed after a search is performed must be color coded for easy identification of dispute cases based upon the dispute case status.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: System failures of downstream systems shall be transparent and include guidance on whether the user should call support or use alternative processes; historical outages during peak times must be considered in resilience planning.
